description: This file contains the implementation of the InterleavedSincResampler class, which performs audio resampling using sinc kernels with windowing, buffer management, and convolution methods.

classes.name: InterleavedSincResampler
classes.description: A class implementing sinc-based audio resampling with buffer management and kernel convolution.

methods.name: InterleavedSincResampler::InitializeKernel
methods.description: Generates windowed sinc kernels for resampling.

methods.name: InterleavedSincResampler::GetNumberOfCachedFrames
methods.description: Returns the number of frames currently cached in the buffer.

methods.name: InterleavedSincResampler::QueueBuffer
methods.description: Queues an input buffer for resampling.

methods.name: InterleavedSincResampler::Resample
methods.description: Performs resampling on queued buffers into the destination buffer.

methods.name: InterleavedSincResampler::Flush
methods.description: Resets internal state and clears buffers.

methods.name: InterleavedSincResampler::CanQueueBuffer
methods.description: Checks if a new buffer can be queued.

methods.name: InterleavedSincResampler::HasEnoughData
methods.description: Checks if enough data is available for resampling.

methods.name: InterleavedSincResampler::Read
methods.description: Reads frames from queued buffers into the destination.

methods.name: InterleavedSincResampler::Convolve
methods.description: Performs convolution of input data with sinc kernels for resampling.
